# NewRssFeed

NewRssFeed is an open-source project in development. Its goal is to explore bringing content from YouTube, Reddit, GitHub, X, and Medium into one feed, with a planned shared-discovery experience for friends. These integrations and social features are goals; availability in a beta release has not been confirmed.

## Current status

- The public website is a project landing page and interface concept, not the live product.
- Beta access is not open and no opening date has been announced.
- The beta application form opens an email draft. The visitor must press Send; the site does not store or submit applications automatically.
- Pricing and product data-handling details have not been announced.
- Source code: https://github.com/korayozkan/NewRssFeedbeta
- Contact: kiruhiofficial@proton.me
